0.0: I think the Lucky 3!3!3! Event is the PERFECT time to do a census. After all, I want to make sure I have precise records of EVERY citizen in Maple World. Purely to keep my files up to date, of course. Nothing nefarious. \r\nIf you #rlog in and complete an attendance check at least 3 times a week#k between #b5/27/2015#k and #6/2/2015#k, I'll even throw you into a raffle for some free #bMaple Points#k. What do you say?

no.0: Evading the census, eh? I wonder what you're trying to hide. Don't worry, I WILL find out.

yes.0: Wonderful. I'd better start preparing my files, because my records are about to get seriously straightened out. My census runs until #b6/2/2015#k, so do NOT miss out. I mean it.

default.0: Don't try to fake your way into my good graces. I know you haven't completed your attendance check yet.
